title: Kyran Thrax wins UK Series 6
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S06-E10), Kyran Thrax and La Voix lip-synced to Queen's "Don't Stop Me Now". Kyran was crowned the winner and received the series' £25,000 cash prize — the first cash prize on a UK main series. La Voix finished as runner-up; Marmalade and Rileasa Slaves placed third and fourth.

title: First UK main-series cash prize
summary: RuPaul's Drag Race UK Series 6 was the first UK main series to award a cash prize, with the winner receiving £25,000. Earlier UK series crowned a winner without a cash prize.

title: Dita Garbo: Series 6 Porkchop
summary: Dita Garbo was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race UK Series 6 (UK-S06-E03), lip-syncing to Duran Duran's "Girls on Film" against Kiki Snatch.

title: Saki Yew withdraws after knee injury
summary: In UK-S06-E02, Saki Yew was forced to withdraw from the competition due to a knee injury. Actavia and Kiki Snatch had been announced as the bottom two, but no further elimination took place; instead Chanel O'Conor, Lill, and Marmalade lip-synced for the win.

title: Charra Tea voted Miss Congeniality
summary: At the Grand Finale (UK-S06-E10), Charra Tea was voted Miss Congeniality by her fellow Series 6 contestants after placing sixth.
